newsitem.title: USA: Trouble seen for budget amendment in U.S. House.
newsitem.headline: Trouble seen for budget amendment in U.S. House.

text.p: Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle on Monday predicted the Republicans' balanced budget amendment would have great difficulty passing the House and that the vote would be extremely close in the Senate.

"I think the Republicans are in trouble in the House," he told reporters. The House Judiciary Committee cancelled its vote, which was scheduled for Tuesday, on the proposed constitutional amendment after it appeared Democrats might have the votes to exempt Social Security.
The Senate began debate on its version last week and will vote later Monday on an amendment to permit deficits in recessions.
